about: The 240 roots of E8 under A4 + A4' (layer 24, oes/assignment.py). The carrier's A4 is taken as SU(5) with colour sites 0, 1, 2 and weak sites 3, 4, and the orientation (10,5) + (5b,10) is taken as matter (SELECTED_REFERENCE; every choice is W(E8)-equivalent). 'triangle_selection' marks the three generations on the twin triangle {0, 1, 2}, which is CONDITIONAL on the bracket rule. A '~' marks an antiparticle. DYN_BIND stays NOT_INSTALLED.
